comment: Every item in the game. value is the shop price in coins; shops buy back at 40%. Items don't stack unless stackable is true. tool.bonus is added to the chance of success per attempt. heals is hitpoints restored when eaten. equip: the slot it is worn in, its attack/strength/defence bonuses, and the level needed (Attack for weapons, Defence for armour; 1 when left out). magic is the bonus to casting spells (metal armour gets in the way). skill overrides which level is needed (Magic for staves and robes). Staves with staffOf stand in for every glyph of that element a spell needs. Weapons attack every 4 ticks unless they give a speed; style picks the animation. Bows (style shoot) need a Ranged level, hit from up to `range` tiles away, and fire the best arrows in the pack that the player can use; ammo.strength is an arrow's strength bonus. Axes and pickaxes can be wielded and still work as tools. burn: the Firemaking level and XP for lighting a log with a tinderbox. clean: a grimy herb's Herblore level and XP, and the clean herb it becomes. bury: Prayer XP for burying bones (or scattering ashes). drink: a potion dose; boost raises each skill by base + pct% of its level, prayer restores base + pct% of the Prayer level, fireward is how many ticks dragonfire is softened; next is what is left in the hand. Seeds and produce belong to Farming (farming.json), shards and glyphs to Glyphcraft (glyphs.json).
